title: 健康长寿 Day 2 — 营养基本盘

questions.question: 为什么不能把胶原蛋白当作主要的蛋白质来源？
options: 它的亮氨酸含量极低，达不到触发肌肉蛋白合成的阈值
它分子太大难以吸收，大部分会原样排出体外
它属于植物来源的蛋白，生物利用度天然就低于各类动物蛋白
它会加重肾脏的代谢负担，健康人长期吃也有风险
questions.explanation: 肌肉蛋白合成由亮氨酸触发，每餐要达到约 2.5 g 的阈值；胶原蛋白亮氨酸极少，只能作辅助。「高蛋白伤肾」文章明确说只对已有中重度肾病的人成立。
questions.question_en: Why shouldn't collagen be your main protein source?
options_en: Its leucine content is very low, too little to trigger muscle protein synthesis
Its molecules are too large to absorb, so most of it passes through unused
It is a plant protein, so its bioavailability is inherently lower than animal protein
It strains the kidneys, which is risky even for healthy people long term
questions.explanation_en: Muscle protein synthesis is triggered by leucine, roughly 2.5 g per meal. Collagen has very little, so it can only play a supporting role. The article says the 'protein harms kidneys' worry only applies to people who already have moderate-to-severe kidney disease.

questions.question: 文章认为膳食纤维比益生菌胶囊更能改善肠道菌群，理由是什么？
options: 纤维能先杀死肠道里的有害菌，给后续补充的益生菌腾出空间
益生菌会和原生菌群争夺营养，长期吃反而降低菌群多样性
多数益生菌过胃后难以存活定植，纤维则直接喂养体内原有的菌群
纤维本身含有大量活菌，吃下去相当于一次补充了更多种类的益生菌
questions.explanation: 益生菌胶囊的问题是过胃后存活率低、定植失败；膳食纤维是益生元，被大肠里原本就住着的菌群发酵，产生丁酸等短链脂肪酸。纤维本身并不含活菌。
questions.question_en: Why does the article say dietary fiber beats probiotic capsules for improving the gut microbiome?
options_en: Fiber first kills harmful gut bacteria, clearing room for probiotics taken afterward
Probiotics compete with resident microbes for nutrients and reduce diversity over time
Most probiotics die or fail to colonize after the stomach, while fiber feeds the microbes already living there
Fiber itself contains many live bacteria, so it delivers more strains at once
questions.explanation_en: Probiotic capsules mostly fail to survive the stomach or take hold. Fiber is a prebiotic: the resident microbes in the colon ferment it into short-chain fatty acids like butyrate. Fiber contains no live bacteria itself.

questions.question: 买鱼油时，文章提醒最该看标签上的哪一项？
options: 鱼油的总毫克数，单粒剂量越大的软胶囊效果越好
每粒的 EPA+DHA 实际含量，而不是鱼油的总毫克数
是否混入了亚麻籽油，植物与鱼类两种来源搭配起来吸收更全面
是否来自深海鱼，只要是深海鱼来源，含量差别就不大
questions.explanation: 一粒 1000 mg 的鱼油软胶囊常常只含约 300 mg EPA+DHA，所以要看有效成分而非总量。亚麻籽里的 ALA 转化成 EPA/DHA 的效率极低，不能拿来替代。
questions.question_en: When buying fish oil, what does the article say to check on the label above all?
options_en: The total milligrams of fish oil, since bigger capsules work better
The actual EPA+DHA per capsule, not the total milligrams of fish oil
Whether flaxseed oil is blended in, since mixing plant and fish sources aids absorption
Whether it comes from deep-sea fish; if so, the content barely varies
questions.explanation_en: A 1000 mg fish-oil softgel often contains only about 300 mg of EPA+DHA, so check the active content, not the total. The ALA in flaxseed converts to EPA/DHA very poorly and is no substitute.
